units.text: 是的，即使您从未在Social Security下工作过，只要您年满62岁且您的配偶正在领取退休或残疾福利，您就可能符合配偶退休福利的资格。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'Even if you have never worked under Social Security, you may be able to get spouse's retirement benefits if you are at least 62 years of age and your spouse is receiving retirement or disability benefits.'

units.text: 您也可以在65岁时获得Medicare资格。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'You can also qualify for Medicare at age 65.'

units.text: 如果您离婚了，您可能仍有资格基于前配偶的记录获得福利。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'If you are divorced, you may still be able to get benefits on your ex-spouse's record.'

units.text: 请注意，如果您在62岁至完全退休年龄之间开始领取福利，金额将永久减少；
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'If you begin receiving benefits: - between age 62 and your full retirement age, the amount will be permanently reduced by a percentage based on the number of months up to your full retirement age.'

units.text: 在完全退休年龄时，配偶福利不能超过您配偶完全退休金额的一半。
supporting_chunk_ids: Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'at your full retirement age, your benefit as a spouse cannot exceed one-half of your spouse's full retirement amount.'

units.text: 您可以通过在线、电话或当地办公室申请。
